## Maps and Tokens for Chapter 4

Session 4 is a single continuous dungeon crawl across three maps. Load all three before
players join; reposition tokens room-by-room on the middle map rather than reloading it
between scenes.

### Scene → Map → Tokens

| Scene | Map File | Tokens to Place | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scene 0: The Marsh | `Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/SkeletonFortressEntrance/Skeleton Fortress Entrance Public/SkeletonFortressEntrancePublic.jpg` | All PCs, Tribune_Lucius, Banshee ×2 | Banshees rise when the party is mid-causeway, not on arrival. Stagger their Wails. |
| Scene 1: The Ossuary | `Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/BloodCultDungeon/Blood Cult Dungeon Public/Blood-Cult-Dungeon-Gridded-29x43-MapPublic.jpg` (west skull room) | All PCs, Bone_Naga ×2 | Position in the circular skull-shaped room, west side of the map. |
| Scene 2: The Blood-Growth Rooms | Same map, east rooms | All PCs, Yochlol ×1, Dretch ×2 | The two rooms thick with fleshy growths, east side of the map. |
| Scene 3: The Minor Altar | Same map, center room | All PCs, Shadow_Demon ×2 | The glowing dais + 4 pillars room at the map's center. |
| Scene 4: The Rune Lock | Same map, south of center | All PCs (no combat tokens by default) | The room with the 4 glowing sigil tiles. Optional Dretch ambush if pacing needs it. |
| Scene 5: The Gathering Hall | Same map, south end | All PCs, Wraith ×3 | The two chieftains + a devoted follower, all three Wraiths. Stagger Create Specter. |
| Scene 6: The Core Room | `Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/CastleCoreRoom/Castle Core Room Public/CastleCoreRoomPublic.jpg` | All PCs, Glabrezu ×1 | The circular sanctum with the crystal-star focus on the dais. |

::: {.dm-note}
If `Glabrezu.rptok` doesn't exist yet in `Maptool/tokens/npcs/creatures/`, it needs a
`npcs/glabrezu.json` sheet and a `creature_stats.json` entry generated the same way the
other 5 Session 4 monsters were (see SCRUM_BACKLOG.md Epic 8's commit history) before
this session can be run in MapTool.
:::

### Map Files Location

These three maps are not yet copied into a campaign session folder --
`build_campaign_maps.sh` needs a new S4 block matching this session's actual content
(see below). Source files:

```
Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/SkeletonFortressEntrance/Skeleton Fortress Entrance Public/SkeletonFortressEntrancePublic.jpg
Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/BloodCultDungeon/Blood Cult Dungeon Public/Blood-Cult-Dungeon-Gridded-29x43-MapPublic.jpg
Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/CastleCoreRoom/Castle Core Room Public/CastleCoreRoomPublic.jpg
```

Run `bash Maptool/maps/build_campaign_maps.sh` to copy session tokens into the campaign
folder (idempotent) once the S4 block below is added.

### Required build_campaign_maps.sh changes (S4 block)

The current S4 block still copies old siege-era assets (`s4_fort_siege.html`, the tunnel
SVGs, `NatureGoddessTemple`, Berserker/Tribal_Warrior/Legionary crowds, Quintus_Flavius,
Cultist_of_Mars). All of that is obsolete for this session's actual content. Replace with:

```bash
# Dice Grimorium / custom maps for the Blood Cult Dungeon
cp "$DG/SkeletonFortressEntrance/Skeleton Fortress Entrance Public/SkeletonFortressEntrancePublic.jpg" "$S/"
cp "$DG/BloodCultDungeon/Blood Cult Dungeon Public/Blood-Cult-Dungeon-Gridded-29x43-MapPublic.jpg" "$S/"
cp "$DG/CastleCoreRoom/Castle Core Room Public/CastleCoreRoomPublic.jpg" "$S/"

# NPCs
copy_npc "Tribune_Lucius" "$S"

# Creatures
for slug in Banshee Bone_Naga Yochlol Dretch Shadow_Demon Wraith Glabrezu; do
  copy_npc "$slug" "$S"
done
```

This is deliberate design work for Story 8.8, not yet applied to the actual script --
apply it as its own commit once confirmed.
